nv06_report.definition: relative difference = (k_dat - k_direct) / k_direct; k_direct = abep_chem::checked::maxwellian_rate on the registered representation (EQ-06), k_dat = linear interpolation of the registered .dat at 3/2 T_e (cross-check only, never used). T_e = 2, 10, 20, 30 eV fall on table rows; 3, 5, 7.5, 15 eV between rows.
summary: On table rows every |difference| <= 4.35e-07: the .dat is the same integral printed to 7 significant digits.

Between rows the 1 eV linear interpolation overestimates the steep threshold rates at ICP-class T_e: at T_e = 3 eV +238 % (N2 -> N^2+ + N), +153 % (direct N -> N^2+, all three HMS members), +108 % (N2 -> N2^2+), +59 % (N+ -> N^2+), +44 % / +42 % (DI lower / upper), +16 % (N2 -> N2+), +10 % (dissociation); <= 4.7 % for the 16 electronic channels, <= 0.26 % for rotational and elastic. At T_e = 5 eV the same channels give +31 %, +18 %, +11 %, +7.1 %, +6.1 % / +5.7 %, +1.9 %, +1.1 %.

This is the effect EQ-06 anticipates (direct evaluation chosen because the 1 eV grid is coarse for threshold rates at low mean energy). UQ-06 carries it as a scenario pair in the OUT-13 envelope, which stays NOT_EVALUATED until abep-rng is admitted (IMPL-UQ).
